description: Bilinear multi-label model with free/EL/text term towers and DGZ checkpoint compatibility, the trainer and run CLI (typed EL loss, masked BCE, per-component per-tower grad-norm logging, --device auto|cuda|cpu, preflight re-running withholding assertions), study.json, and the checkpoint gates G3 (local), G2b (local) and G4 (implemented, remote). Plan items 11-13 of plan_go_function.md. Depends on FEAT-001 (normforms, labels), FEAT-002 (evaluate.py, features, gate downloads) and FEAT-003 (withholding assertions, conditions, target table).
steps: Plan item 11: go_function/model.py per design section 6: MLPBlock + residual protein tower with norm 'layernorm'|'batchnorm1d'; V0 free Linear term rows; EL arms Embedding(|V|+|Z|, d) + radius Embedding, rel_embed with hasFunc row, go_norm BatchNorm1d inside EL only, uniform init +-sqrt(1/d); V5 Linear(768, d, bias=False) over frozen text + free bias; V6 text centres + free owl:Nothing centre/radius; nf1-nf4 losses ported from DGZ deepgozero.py (web_fetch raw.githubusercontent.com/bio-ontology-research-group/deepgozero/main/deepgozero.py, cited), margin 0.1, nf4_radius 'dgz'|'class'; masked BCE (mask None -> plain path); DgzCompatModel.load(path, strict=True) with CheckpointMismatch listing keys/shapes; hidden_dim configurable. G4 (remote): gate_trainer.py --write-specs wrote 4 specs in results/go_function/specs/gates/: bp_V0_s42.json, bp_V4_s42.json, mf_V0_s42.json, mf_V4_s42.json. All four use mode gate, feature interpro, regime DGZ, condition 'all' (pack null, k 'all', rule W2), selection best_valid_loss, epochs 256, seed 42, lambda_el 1.0 for V4 (null for V0), nf4_radius dgz, and out_dir results/go_function/gates/runs/<aspect>_<variant>_s42. --fallback adds seeds 13/21; --diagnostic adds V4 nf4_radius 'class' under specs/gates/diagnostic/. Compare mode (no flag) reads each run's eval.json 'dgz_faithful' {auc, fmax} and checks it against dgz_published.json at +-0.01. If seed 42 misses, the 3-seed mean is used; missing fallback runs give exit 4, a miss gives exit 3 with gate_trainer.FAILED.json. On pass it writes gates/gate_trainer.json and pin G4. Not run here.

RUN.PY SPEC SCHEMA (go_function.train.validate_spec; unknown or missing fields -> exit 2, nothing written):
- Required fields:
  - aspect bp|mf
  - feature esm2_650m|interpro
  - variant V0|V1|V2|V3|V3c|V4|V5|V6
  - regime TP|DGZ|TPnoIPI (MF only)
  - rule W2|W1|WDGZrel|W2drop (WDGZrel/W2drop: DGZ, k 0)
  - pack p01..p08 or null (null iff k 'all'; the 'all' condition uses rule W2 or W1)
  - k 0|1|5|10|25|'all'
  - seed int (study: 13/21/42/87/123)
  - epochs 1..256 (study: must equal study.json epochs_star['<aspect>_<feature>'])
  - lambda_el (float > 0 for EL arms, null otherwise; = study 1.0 in study/gate mode)
  - batch_size, lr, milestones, gamma (must equal study.json)
  - selection final|best_valid_loss (gate only; study must be final)
  - out_dir (repo-relative, under results/go_function/)
  - mode study|gate|pilot|smoke
- Optional fields:
  - retention_draw 1|2 (2 only for W2/TP/k in {1,5}; default 1)
  - max_train_batches int >= 1 (smoke only)
  - nf4_radius dgz|class (class only gate + V4, the D10 diagnostic; otherwise = study.json)
- Condition dir: preprocess/go_function/<aspect>/conditions/<regime>/<rule>/<pack>_k<k>[_d2] or <regime>/all.
- Run name: <variant>__<regime>__<rule>__<pack|all>__k<k>[__d2]__s<seed>.
- run.py --spec PATH --device auto|cuda|cpu (argparse choices; --device mps is rejected with exit 2; auto -> cpu on the Mac).
- Exit codes: 0 ok; 2 fatal; 3 protocol stop; 4 refused (study.json norm null, missing pin/code_pin in study mode, out_dir not empty or DONE).

LOOP: Adam, MultiStepLR, torch.Generator(seed) shuffling, seed_everything, use_deterministic_algorithms(warn_only), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8. On CUDA the labels are dense bool on device; on CPU they are densified per batch; InterPro CSR rows are densified per batch. loss_mask() returns None for 0 mask pairs, so no tensor is built (masked_bce plain path); WDGZrel/W2drop build a whole-column mask.
epochs.jsonl per epoch: train_bce, el per form + el_total, valid_bce_target_free (validation-mask columns excluded), lr, seconds, n_batches. Every 50th batch it logs grad norms of BCE and lambda*EL on the protein tower (net.*) and the term tower (everything else), plus their ratio per tower (_grad_norm reimplemented with attribution). A non-finite loss or gradient raises NonFiniteLoss, giving FAILED.json stage train.

OUTPUT FILES per run (out_dir):
- epochs.jsonl
- eval_inputs.npz (test logits; deleted after success, kept when stage eval fails)
- eval.json:
  - study/pilot/smoke: per-target class AUC/AUPR/n_pos on raw logits, eval set of eval_label_source; collateral fmax/tmax/smin/aupr_micro/aupr_protein over E.collateral_terms with TP max-propagation and IC from train+valid
  - gate: dgz_faithful {fmax, smin, aupr, auc} after DGZ-rule propagation
- scores.npz (logits float32 n_eval x cols, columns, column_ids, eval_rows; t + Pa + siblings, with X and Desc only for V4 at k 0; not written by gate runs)
- checkpoint.pt (gate/pilot runs, and study 'all' at seed 13)
- run.json (spec, condition, input hashes, info incl. assertions_rerun and code pin, train summary incl. mask_tensor and n_masked_entries, output hashes, environment, wall seconds, study sha)
- DONE.json (hashes); on failure FAILED.json {stage preflight|train|eval, error, message, traceback frames}, all repo-relative.

CLOSED-WORLD TEST (orchestrator requirement): test_train.py::test_closed_world_w2_trainer_mask_equals_base_mask[TP|DGZ x k 0|1|5] checks two things over every seeded batch of the 30-protein fixture. First, the trainer's per-row mask for W2 and for the base data ('all') is None in both, so the masks are identical and no tensor exists. Second, the only label differences are exactly the erased entries of withheld proteins, and nothing is added. test_closed_world_trainer_builds_no_mask_and_trains_on_erased_zeros checks summary mask_tensor false, and also checks that WDGZrel masks whole target columns on every row.
